steps.details: A fixed amount of Ce(NO3)3⋅6H2O was used and complexed with EDTA solution at pH 10 to get the chemical species of Ce [EDTA]-. The MMO from the HT was added to the solution (1 mol of Ce for each 3 mol of Ni) and vigorously stirred for 24 h.

evidence.text_snippet: A fixed amount of Ce(NO3)3⋅6H2O (Merck, 99.99 %) was used and complexed with EDTA solution at pH 10 to get the chemical species of Ce [EDTA]-. The MMO from the HT was added to the solution (1 mol of Ce for each 3 mol of Ni) and vigorously stirred for 24 h.

evidence.text_snippet: The SYT values followed the order MMONiCo + Ce (168 mol CH4 h  1 L  1)

evidence.section: 3.2.3. Extent of the process: yield and stability of the best MMO
evidence.text_snippet: MMONiCo (150 mol CH4 h  1 L  1)

evidence.section: 3.2.3. Extent of the process: yield and stability of the best MMO
evidence.text_snippet: MMONi + Ce (148 mol CH4 h  1 L  1)

evidence.section: 3.2.3. Extent of the process: yield and stability of the best MMO
evidence.text_snippet: MMONiFe + Ce (108 mol CH4 h  1 L  1)

evidence.section: 3.2.3. Extent of the process: yield and stability of the best MMO
evidence.text_snippet: OMNi (105 mol CH4 h  1 L  1)

evidence.section: 3.2.3. Extent of the process: yield and stability of the best MMO
evidence.text_snippet: MMONiFe (80 mol CH4 h  1 L  1)

evidence.section: ABSTRACT
evidence.text_snippet: showing ~85% conversion of CO2 after 1400 min of continuous use.

evidence.section: 3.2.3. Extent of the process: yield and stability of the best MMO
evidence.text_snippet: Remarkably MMONiCo + Ce remained more stable than MMONiCo with no significant changes in catalytic activity (~85 % of CO2 conversion after 1400 min of continuous use).

evidence.section: 3.2.3. Extent of the process: yield and stability of the best MMO
evidence.text_snippet: exhibiting CO2 conversions higher than 80 % even after 1400 min.
